The lifelike voices in SomnuMatrix (on computers) are made on the player's own computer with:

- Kokoro-82M, the voice model by hexgrad. Apache License 2.0. The model files are read from
  https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX and kept on the computer after the first time.
- kokoro-js 1.2.1 (kokoro.web.js in this folder), by hexgrad and Xenova. Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE-kokoro-js.txt).
  The file bundles, unchanged:
  - Transformers.js 3.5.1 by Hugging Face. Apache License 2.0. https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
  - ONNX Runtime Web 1.22 by Microsoft (its JavaScript; its .wasm file is read from the jsDelivr CDN). MIT License.
    https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
  - phonemizer.js 1.2.1 by Xenova (Apache License 2.0), which contains eSpeak NG compiled to WebAssembly.
    eSpeak NG is under the GNU General Public License version 3; its source is at https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
    and phonemizer.js's source at https://github.com/xenova/phonemizer.js. It is used unchanged, as a separate file
    run in its own worker.
- kokoro-worker.js is SomnuMatrix's own.
